description: This source file defines the HealthTracker class in Apache Spark, responsible for monitoring and excluding problematic executors and nodes based on failure patterns, with support for timeouts and external configuration. It includes logic for handling fetch failures, executor failures, and node exclusions, as well as configuration validation.

classes.name: HealthTracker
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking executor and node health, managing exclusions based on failures, and handling related configurations.

classes.name: ExecutorFailureList
classes.description: Inner class that tracks failure times for individual executors to determine exclusion eligibility.

classes.name: ExcludedExecutor
classes.description: Case class representing an excluded executor with its node and expiry time.

methods.name: applyExcludeOnFailureTimeout
methods.description: Removes executors and nodes from exclusion lists if their exclusion timeout has expired.

methods.name: updateNextExpiryTime
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for the next scheduled expiry check based on current exclusions.

methods.name: killExecutor
methods.description: Kills or decommissions an executor based on configuration, with a message.

methods.name: killExcludedExecutor
methods.description: Kills an executor that has been excluded.

methods.name: killExcludedIdleExecutor
methods.description: Kills an idle executor that has been excluded.

methods.name: killExecutorsOnExcludedNode
methods.description: Kills or decommissions all executors on a node that is excluded.

methods.name: updateExcludedForFetchFailure
methods.description: Excludes a node or executor upon fetch failure detection.

methods.name: updateExcludedForSuccessfulTaskSet
methods.description: Updates failure counts and exclusions based on successful task set execution.

methods.name: isExecutorExcluded
methods.description: Checks if an executor is currently excluded.

methods.name: excludedNodeList
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe set of currently excluded nodes.

methods.name: isNodeExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a node is currently excluded.

methods.name: handleRemovedExecutor
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an executor is removed.
